title: CashBack Motors
description: A bilingual (English and Arabic, right-to-left) showcase website for a motorcycle and scooter shop in Alexandria. Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, and deployed on Vercel.

title: EVE Robot
description: A teleoperated robot built with ROS 2 and a Raspberry Pi 4, driven by a PlayStation controller and using ultrasonic sensors for distance sensing.

title: SIC/XE Assembler
description: A two-pass assembler for the SIC/XE architecture, written in Python. The first pass builds the symbol table and location counter, and the second generates object code.

title: Bean Plant Classification
description: A LightGBM classifier for bean plant varieties, trained on a Kaggle dataset in Google Colab and reaching 93.15% accuracy.
